cause: The allocation had Network=(null), so Frontier Slurm did not provision the allocation-time CXI VNI required by the current system configuration. Both native processes failed closed in transport_open before endpoint creation or dense allocation. The correction also binds and enables registered regions when CXI advertises FI_MR_ENDPOINT.
correction: Request single_node_vni,job_vni at sbatch allocation time; require SLURM_NETWORK and SLINGSHOT_VNIS; implement fi_mr_bind plus fi_mr_enable for FI_MR_ENDPOINT.
